note: Extracted from the official PDF; the Ministry publishes no CSV or API. The published headline figure is 'about 3,600 occupations across 52 divisions'; this parse recovers the concordance rows, which is fewer, because titles broken across a page boundary by the PDF's text layer cannot be recovered reliably and are dropped rather than guessed at. That makes this list a FLOOR on NCO coverage: it can under-report a gap, never invent one. Codes ending .9900 are '…, Other' residual buckets and are flagged so the gap search can skip them.
